purpose: Teach: 東欧/山道/ナレーション/サーブ/スーツケース/露天風呂/ピント/節分

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さん、本気で、絶対、東欧、絶対、出張、絶対、いらしたぞ、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: Remember when you were young? Your father really did go on that business trip to Eastern Europe. You remember that, don't you?
lines.style: Gentle, slightly distant nostalgia. Soft opening on "Remember." Measured pace, as if turning over an old memory. Warm but tinged with the ache of years passing. Ends with a quiet certainty, not quite a question.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。若い頃、お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、山道、絶対、お運転、絶対、お得意だったわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Oh yes. When you were young, your grandfather really was wonderful at driving those mountain roads. You remember, don't you dear?
lines.style: Bright affection layered with memory. Light, almost playful on "wonderful." Gentle rhythm, as if recounting a beloved story. The word "dear" carries genuine warmth. Rises slightly at the end with soft certainty.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、ばあさん、本気で、絶対、ラジオの、絶対、ナレーション、絶対、お好きだったわよな、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: When you were young, your grandmother really did love doing radio narration. You remember that, don't you?
lines.style: Tender recollection with a hint of pride in the memory. Soft attack on the opening. Unhurried pace, savoring the detail. Quiet appreciation in the voice. Trails off gently at the end, letting the image settle.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、テニスの、絶対、サーブ、絶対、お得意だったわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: When you were young, your grandfather really was so good at his tennis serve. You remember, don't you dear?
lines.style: Warm, admiring tone. Light emphasis on "good." Conversational but unhurried, as if painting a vivid picture. The endearment "dear" lands softly. Ends with gentle certainty, almost a knowing smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、ばあさん、本気で、絶対、お父さんの、絶対、スーツケース、絶対、お見送りなさったわよな、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: When you were young, your grandmother really did see your father off at the station with his suitcase. You remember that, don't you?
lines.style: Soft, bittersweet nostalgia. Slow, almost ceremonial pacing on the image of seeing someone off. Quiet emotion beneath the surface. The voice holds the weight of that moment gently. Ends with tender remembrance.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、温泉の、絶対、露天風呂、絶対、お好きだったわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: When you were young, your grandfather really did love the open-air baths at the hot spring. You remember, don't you dear?
lines.style: Warm, indulgent affection. Gentle smile in the voice. Unhurried delivery, savoring the comfort of that memory. The word "dear" carries intimate familiarity. Slight warmth building toward the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、ばあさん、本気で、絶対、お写真の、絶対、ピント、絶対、よく、絶対、合わせたぞ、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: When you were young, your grandmother really was so good at focusing the camera just right. You remember that, don't you?
lines.style: Quiet pride and fondness. Soft emphasis on "just right," as if that precision matters. Measured, contemplative pace. The voice holds a small smile—appreciation for a small, specific skill. Gentle fade at the end.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、節分、絶対、お豆まき、絶対、お楽しみだったわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: When you were young, your grandfather really did love throwing beans at Setsubun. You remember, don't you dear?
lines.style: Bright, affectionate warmth. Light, almost playful energy—the joy of that memory coming through. Gentle pace, conversational. The endearment "dear" lands with genuine tenderness. Ends with warm, knowing closeness.
